briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 intensify AGI race as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push multi-modal models toward 2027 AGI thresholds while regulatory scrutiny mounts. US-China chip export controls tighten, accelerating domestic buildouts. Prompt injection attacks surge in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4-preview with 40% gains on SWE-Bench; Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek R2 matches GPT-5 level on math benchmarks at 1/5th cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 2M units; Microsoft and xAI announce 100k H100-equivalent clusters; TSMC 2nm yields improve for 2027 AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first model to reach 90% on GPQA Diamond trigger immediate export controls or a new international treaty?
